## Gradle JMH invocations

```bash
# Snapshot run — throughput / latency / CPU hotpaths
./gradlew jmh -Pjmh.include=<BenchmarkClass>
# JMH flags: -wi 3 -i 5 -r 2s -f 2
# Profiler:  -prof async:output=collapsed;file=profiler.collapsed

# Sustained run — growth, leaks, degradation over time
./gradlew jmh -Pjmh.include=<BenchmarkClass>
# JMH flags: -wi 5 -i 30 -r 5s -f 1
# Profiler:  -prof async:event=alloc;output=collapsed;file=alloc.collapsed
#            -prof jfr

# Scratch run (either mode — same flags, different include pattern)
./gradlew jmh -Pjmh.include=<Name>Scratch
```

> Confirm exact `-Pjmh.*` property names match your Gradle JMH plugin version
> before first use. Update this section if they differ.
new_string:
## Gradle JMH invocations

Plugin: `me.champeau.jmh` v0.7.2, JMH 1.37

```bash
# Benchmark modules (each has its own jmh task):
#   :benchmarks:jlsm-bloom-benchmarks:jmh
#   :benchmarks:jlsm-tree-benchmarks:jmh

# Run all benchmarks in a module
./gradlew :benchmarks:jlsm-bloom-benchmarks:jmh

# Filter to a specific benchmark class (plugin property: jmh.includes)
./gradlew :benchmarks:jlsm-tree-benchmarks:jmh -Pjmh.includes=StandardLsmTreeBenchmark

# With async-profiler flamegraph (HTML output to build/profiler-results/)
# Requires: ./gradlew :downloadAsyncProfiler  (or use jmhProfile which auto-downloads)
./gradlew :benchmarks:jlsm-bloom-benchmarks:jmhProfile -Pprofile
./gradlew :benchmarks:jlsm-bloom-benchmarks:jmhProfile -Pprofile -PprofileEvent=alloc

# Sustained run override — set fork=1 and increase iterations in build.gradle or annotations
# -Pprofile already sets fork=1; for sustained runs, also override warmup/iterations
```

### Default JMH settings per module

| Module | Fork | Warmup | Measurement | Notes |
|--------|------|--------|-------------|-------|
| jlsm-bloom-benchmarks | 2 | 3x1s | 5x1s | Set in build.gradle `jmh {}` block |
| jlsm-tree-benchmarks | (annotation) | 3x5s | 5x5s | No `jmh {}` overrides; annotations on class |

> To override for sustained runs, add `jmh { fork = 1; iterations = 30; timeOnIteration = '5s' }`
> or use annotation overrides on the benchmark class.
